crossRefs.note: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

people.name: Attai
people.line: Grandson of Sheshan, descendant of Judah

people.name: Jarha
people.line: Egyptian servant who married Sheshan's daughter

people.name: Sheshan
people.line: Jerahmeelite whose daughter married his Egyptian servant

translations.web: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
translations.bsb: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
translations.kjv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
translations.asv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
